message.title: Aker ASA: Nscale files registration statement for proposed initial public offering
message.body:
Nscale Limited ("Nscale"), Aker ASA's second largest portfolio holding, has
today announced that it has filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with
the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") relating to a proposed
initial public offering of its ordinary shares.

A copy of the registration statement may be obtained on the SEC's website. The
registration statement has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become
effective.

For more information, see www.nscale.com/newsroom

-ENDS-
